rationale: This is clearly an auto collision claim: a motor vehicle was struck and totaled, causing both vehicle damage and bodily injury to the policyholder.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 by a vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. The policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; a police report was filed with the other driver's insurance information included.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other driver going approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info included
